body:
Circular Steel was established to accelerate the reuse of structural steel by bringing together the organisations capable of delivering it. While interest in circular construction continues to grow, reuse at scale depends on coordination across multiple disciplines - engineering, demolition, fabrication, design, certification, insurance and policy. Circular Steel exists to create alignment across that ecosystem.

## From ambition to delivery

Through events, partnerships and knowledge exchange, Circular Steel supports the transition from one-off reuse projects to a mature, reliable and investable market. The platform is intentionally practitioner-led - focused on sharing real experience, tackling delivery barriers and strengthening confidence in reuse pathways.

## A growing international community

What began as a UK-focused initiative is now expanding internationally, reflecting growing global momentum around steel reuse and embodied carbon reduction.

## Who is behind Circular Steel

**Steve Gilchrist** - Steve previously organised Circular Steel events in his own time outside full employment. In 2024, it was organised via [Propetual](https://propetual.co.uk), a business Steve recently founded.
